gloss.would: б (I would go = я б вибрав)
gloss.worth: варте (it’s worth it = воно того варте)

clips.line: I would go with the more expensive one, ’cause I would cook with it more than an average person.
clips.note: They tested a cheap and an expensive kitchen gadget. The chef would choose the more expensive one.
clips.noteUa: Вони тестували дешевий і дорогий кухонний прилад. Кухар вибрав би дорожчий.

clips.line: Clearly the more expensive one was better.
clips.note: They compared a cheap knife and an expensive knife. The expensive one was better.
clips.noteUa: Вони порівнювали дешевий і дорогий ніж. Дорожчий виявився кращим.
